newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton futures called to open unchanged.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton futures called to open unchanged.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open unchanged as of 1018 EDT, floor sources said.
"We had wild trading activity the last two days," one floor source said.
On the fundamental side, he noted recent beneficial rains in west Texas and the forecast was for rain to move into the Delta region over the weekend.
He pegged good resistance at 75.00 to 75.20 cents a lb for December delivery, with support seen at 74.00 to 73.80 cents.
